syllabus_topics: Review of mechanical properties. Mechanical tests: tension, compression, hardness, impact, bending.
design for stiffness, design for strength, design for high temperature
material selection, Ashby maps, CES software, weighted indices
Product development: Materials and product development.

assessment_methods.method: Written assessment in 2 Tests or Final Exam

assessment_rules: The minimum grade for the average of the Tests is 8. Individual Tests do not have a minimum grade, but students must attend both to receive a grade for the assessment. The minimum grade for the Exam is 8. The laboratory component is mandatory. Non-attendance at a laboratory session implies a zero grade for that laboratory. The minimum grade for the average of the 3 laboratory grades must be 9.5.
bibliography: Ashby, M., Shercliff, H., and Cebon, D., "Materials: engineering, science, processing and design", 4th Edition, Butterworth-Heineman, 2019 (main)
Ashby, M., Johnson, K., "Materials and Design", 3rd Edition, Butterworth-Heineman, 2014 (secondary)
K. T. Ulrich, S. D. Eppinger, Yang, M, "Product Design and Development", 7 Ed, McGraw-Hill., 2020 (main)
Kevin Otto, Kristin Wood, "Product Design", Prentice-Hall, 2001 (main)
